cues.en: Commander, I require your presence on the bridge.

cues.zh: 舰长，恕我冒昧，也许您最好另选他人
cues.en: Captain, with all due respect, perhaps it would be better if you choose another to serve
Data YOU are my first officer.

cues.zh: 长官，我还没能定位问题所在。我可能会犯错。
cues.en: I have not been able to isolate the problem sir. I might make a mistake.

cues.zh: 没错，你可能会犯错。但这并不能改变你对我、对这艘飞船的职责。
cues.en: Yes, you might. But that does not alter your duty to me and to this ship.

cues.zh: 现在，你知道该如何提出假设吗？
cues.en: Now do you know how to formulate a premise?

cues.zh: 那就针对这个提出假设：我该如何应对 Riker 中校和 Hathaway 号？
cues.en: Then formulate this one. How do I deal with Commander Riker and the Hathaway?

cues.zh: 我会在舰桥等你的答案。
cues.en: I will await your answer on the bridge.

cues.zh: 一个人完全不犯任何错误，却依然可能会输。
cues.en: it is possible, to commit no mistakes, and still lose.

cues.zh: 还有，Data，把你的犹豫和自我怀疑都留在这间宿舍里吧。
cues.en: And Data will you leave your hesitation and self doubt here in your quarters.
